title: Cartan--Eilenberg presentations and comparison lifts
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian categories and $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ an additive functor [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. A Cartan--Eilenberg presentation of $X$ is an injective resolution $J_X$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], extended by zero to integer complex degrees, together with a Cartan--Eilenberg resolution $I_X$ of $F(J_X)$ and its common augmentation, satisfying exactly the five properties of [lem-sp-cartan-eilenberg-exists]. A comparison between two presentations is a triple $(f,\beta,\alpha)$, where $f:X\to Y$, $\beta:J_X\to J_Y$ commutes with the injective-resolution augmentations and $\alpha:I_X\to I_Y$ commutes with the Cartan--Eilenberg augmentations over $F(\beta)$. For an additive $G:\mathcal B\to\mathcal C$, apply $G$ and extend the resolution degree by zero. If $\mathcal C$ is Grothendieck abelian [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], its total complex is the total complex of [def-sp-double-complex-total].
